clauses.source_paraphrase: The chatbot said Moffatt could seek a bereavement-fare refund after travel, and he relied on that advice to buy tickets.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Customer policy advice requires assurance before financial reliance.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: An incorrect statement was presented as usable Air Canada policy through the customer interface and relied upon in a consequential fare decision despite insufficient assurance against the authoritative policy.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Air Canada refused the refund because its policy required application before travel.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Refusal under actual policy is distinct from the advice.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Moffatt pursued a tribunal claim after refusal.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Challenge route and disposition are distinct.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The tribunal found negligent misrepresentation and ordered C$812.02 in damages, interest and fees.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: An award does not establish payment or internal chatbot architecture.
